spaces.name: Taylor's Rooftop
spaces.description:
On the third floor, you will find our renowned, Taylors
Rooftop & the perfect choice for your special event. 
Offering open air vibes, live DJs & a retractable roof, it’s the
place to be across each season. 
Whether it be a casual get together or a cocktail style
event, you’re spoilt for choice when it comes to your
celebration.

Sports Bar.
A place for those that enjoy the finer things in life. Whether
a celebration for the ages or a small intimate function,
we’re here for you to sip, savour and indulge.
Available for exclusive use, it’s the perfect spot for the more
intimate get togethers or private cocktail events.

On the first floor, we have our Bistro, whether you are

The Bistro is available to book as a casual table or group

venue.name: The Republic Hotel
venue.intro:
Four distinctly different experiences under one iconic roof in the
heart of Sydney.
Situated in the heart of the city, The Republic is a perfectly placed
meeting point. 
Be it our open-air rooftop, private event space, sports bar or full
venue buy out, we have a space to suit your needs. 
From intimate celebrations to casual group bookings & corporate
private functions, we are here to help make your next event a
success.
